Core schema (properties, property_members, chapters, media) migrated, private storage bucket set up, RLS tested end-to-end via login+create-property flow in browser. Two RLS gotchas found & fixed (see migrations 003/004: AFTER INSERT triggers fire after RETURNING's SELECT-policy check, not before).
Upload UI built: single+batch file input, optional batch note, uploads to houstory-media storage + creates media rows, triggers analysis, renders suggestions.

analyze-media edge function deployed: runs under caller's own JWT (no service-role bypass), downloads photo, calls Claude with a forced tool-use categorize_photo call, stores suggestion on the media row. Verified end-to-end in browser.

Review/confirm UI built into upload.html: editable chapter_type/title/description/fields, create-new-chapter or attach-to-existing-chapter, photo thumbnail shown. Also added a 'needs review' section that resurfaces previously-uploaded-but-unconfirmed photos (found and preserved Pete's own real test photo this way). Verified end-to-end in browser: both save paths tested at the data level.

Chapter detail view built (chapter.html): edit title/category/description/status, delete chapter (unfiles its photos back to pending_review rather than deleting them), photo grid with per-photo description edit, move-to-another-chapter, and delete. Chapter list in app.html now links to it. Verified end-to-end in browser with throwaway test data: edit+save, move between chapters, delete chapter unfiling confirmed, and confirmed unfiled photo resurfaces correctly in upload.html's needs-review queue.

Added media.title column, analyze-media now suggests a distinct per-photo title (separate from description and suggested_chapter_name), and it's editable in both the upload review form and the chapter detail photo grid. Verified end-to-end in browser with throwaway test data.

Multi-view grouping built: upload.html lets you check 2+ selected files and group them as one item before uploading; analyze-media accepts media_ids (array) and sends all images to Claude in one call via a new categorize_photo_group tool, returning one shared chapter_type/description/suggested_chapter_name/fields plus a distinguishing photo_titles array. Review UI shows a thumbnail strip with per-photo editable titles and one shared description/fields/save-to. Verified end-to-end in browser: grouped 2 photos, Claude correctly distinguished them ('Five Wonders logo' vs '...(duplicate view)'), saved both to one chapter with shared description + distinct titles. Regression-tested ungrouped single-file upload still works. Known limitation: if a group isn't confirmed in the same session, its photos resurface individually (not re-grouped) in the needs-review queue - acceptable scope cut for v1.

Fixed by gating the Upload button rather than just making grouping more visible: for 2+ selected files, Upload stays disabled until the user explicitly answers 'are any of these the same item?' (Yes reveals the group-checkbox UI, No just proceeds with a visible 'uploading as separate photos' note + Change link). A single file skips the gate entirely - zero added friction for the common one-photo-per-item case. Verified all paths in browser: 2-file gate blocks upload until answered, Yes/No/Change all behave correctly, single-file has no gate.

Merge feature built in chapter.html: pick another chapter from a dropdown, confirm, and all photos move there; metadata is shallow-merged (target's values win on conflict), description falls back to the source's if the target has none, and the now-empty source chapter is deleted with a redirect to the surviving target. Verified end-to-end with throwaway test chapters: photo moved, metadata merged correctly, source deleted, redirected to target.

Superseded by houstory-96t.23: analysis is no longer an automatic background step to toggle on/off - submission to Claude is now always explicit (you write instructions and hit Submit), so 'always/ask/never' no longer applies.
Covered by houstory-96t.23: chapter.html's new 'Add existing unfiled photos' picker supports multi-select, so a whole batch of unfiled photos can be bulk-assigned to one chapter in a single action.

Rebuilt upload.html as a freeform playground: pick 1+ photos, write instructions, submit, see Claude's raw text response - no forced chapter_type/title/fields extraction. analyze-media simplified to one path (any number of media_ids + instructions, no tool_choice forcing). Photos save unfiled; app.html gained a manual 'create new chapter' form (moved out of the old upload flow); chapter.html gained an 'add existing unfiled photos' picker (multi-select, also covers houstory-96t.14). Verified end-to-end: created a chapter via the new form, submitted a photo with custom instructions and got a detailed unconstrained response, filed it into the chapter via the new picker, confirmed the unfiled list correctly shrank. This also superseded houstory-96t.16 (closed) and re-scoped houstory-96t.17/96t.18/96t.22 (notes added).
index.html now checks session on load: shows 'Go to your home' -> app.html when signed in, 'Sign in' -> login.html otherwise. Verified both states in browser.

Fixed: getUser() calls replaced with getSession() (auto-refreshes) via a shared requireSession() helper in upload.html and app.html, with a graceful redirect-to-login fallback instead of crashing. Verified both the corrupted-session redirect path and normal submission in browser.

Fixed by resizing images client-side before upload (canvas, capped at 1568px longest edge, JPEG q=0.85) - matches Claude's own effective vision resolution so no analysis quality is lost. Verified: a synthetic 4032x3024 (typical phone camera resolution) image resizes correctly to 1568x1176, and a 2-photo submission at that resolution (which reproduces the same data volume that crashed with HTTP 546) now completes successfully with no error.

Enabled Anthropic's web_search_20250305 tool in analyze-media, with a system prompt nudging Claude toward concrete results (real links/contacts) over descriptions of a search strategy. Verified with Pete's actual Fulgor Milano range: a focused 'find the manual' ask returned the real manual PDF link plus the exact product page (matching what Pete found himself independently), and a focused 'find local repair services' ask returned 5 named Columbus-area businesses with phone numbers plus the nearest authorized Fulgor Milano retailer (Dayton, OH). Key finding: one focused ask per submission gets dramatically better results than bundling multiple lookups together, since Claude spreads across more searches and hedges more when asked for several things at once - added a UI hint in upload.html reflecting this.

Added media.upload_batch_id (set once client-side per submission, migration 006). Unfiled gallery now groups by batch id: one submission = one card with all its thumbnails + one shared description, instead of repeating the description per photo. Added a Delete button per unfiled group with a confirm() dialog, removing all its media rows and storage objects. Verified end-to-end: a 2-photo submission grouped into one card with one description; delete removed both rows from the database. Older pre-migration entries correctly fall back to showing individually (no batch id to group by).

Added a safe markdown-lite renderer (escapeHtml + bold/header/link transforms, no raw HTML from Claude ever reaches innerHTML) applied everywhere ai_description is shown: upload.html's live results and Unfiled gallery, chapter.html's photo cards and unfiled picker. Verified: bold/headers render correctly, bare URLs and markdown-style [text](url) links both become real hyperlinks, and an XSS attempt (<script>alert(1)</script>) is correctly escaped rather than executed.

Added collapsible/expandable cards using a shared card-summary/card-body pattern (thumbnail + derived title, click to expand) applied to: upload.html's live results (expanded by default, since freshly generated) and Unfiled gallery (collapsed by default), and chapter.html's photo cards (collapsed by default). chapter.html's photo description also got a view/edit toggle - rendered by default, 'Edit description' reveals the raw-text textarea, editing and saving correctly re-renders and updates the collapsed summary title. Scope: applied everywhere EXCEPT chapter.html's unfiled-photo checkbox picker, which stayed as a flat list (rendering was still added there) since a picker's rows benefit less from being individually collapsible. Verified end-to-end in browser with throwaway test data.

Removed the 'Add existing unfiled photos' picker from chapter.html entirely (was showing the same unfiled photos duplicated at the bottom of every chapter). upload.html's existing Unfiled section (already collapsed-by-default) is now the one place this happens: each unfiled group gets a 'File into a chapter' dropdown (existing chapters + 'Create new chapter' with name/category fields) and a File button. Filing reloads the Unfiled list so newly-created chapters immediately become available as targets for OTHER still-unfiled groups too. Verified end-to-end: filed one group into a brand-new chapter, filed a second group into that same now-existing chapter, confirmed chapter.html shows both photos with no unfiled section present.

Pete provided the logo artwork (image generated elsewhere, saved to C:/code/houstory/houstory-logo.png). Wired into index.html in place of the plain-text 'Houstory' heading, matching Five Wonders' logo pattern (centered flex wrapper, max-width 260px, .hs-logo-wrap/.hs-logo-img in houstory.css). File loads correctly (verified via curl and server access logs - 200 OK on every request); the local preview browser pane intermittently failed to fetch the ~800KB file through its tunnel, but that's a local testing-tool limitation, not a real bug - the production site is served via GitHub Pages/CDN, not this local setup.

app.html now shows chapters as buttons (styled links to chapter.html) instead of a text list. Seeded the 7 missing named chapters (Appliances, Paint, Projects, Contractors, Materials, Landscaping, Repairs - Iconic Photos already existed). Buttons sort in that canonical order first, with any other existing chapters (Pete's pre-existing Kitchen Appliances/Kitchen Renovation/Paint Colors) sorted alphabetically after. Renamed 'Analyze photos' to 'Add'. Dropped the '(active)'/category suffix entirely from the button labels. Inline chapter-creation form left in place for now (not yet moved to Manage Chapters - that's houstory-96t.34, not part of this bead). Verified end-to-end in browser: correct order, correct styling, clicking a button navigates to the right chapter.
Fixed in app.html ensureProfile() - now backfills empty fields on existing profile rows instead of skipping.

Google sign-in fully verified end-to-end by Pete on his phone: OAuth flow completes, redirects correctly to houstory.homes/app.html (after fixing Supabase URL Configuration), and profile auto-populates name+photo from Google metadata (after fixing the avatar backfill bug in houstory-28w).
Verified by Pete on the Appliances chapter: the 2 duplicate cards from one upload batch now show as 1 grouped card (3 cards -> 2).
Manage Chapters page built (manage-chapters.html) and verified by Pete: create/rename/edit description+status/delete all work, no Category field, no merge UI.
